responsibility: This file is the AArch64 port’s machine option description used by GCC’s generated option machinery. It declares AArch64-specific target variables, enums, user-facing options, and target parameters for architecture and CPU selection, ABI, code model, TLS dialect, SVE vector length, branch and return-address protection, speculation tracking, atomics outlining, stack protection, reciprocal precision, and vectorization tuning, allowing the compiler driver and cc1 to parse and store backend option state in generated code.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-stem aarch64 files, this is the target option description consumed by GCC's option generator: it declares AArch64-specific switches, enums, params, and backing variables. It is not backend execution logic like aarch64.cc, not the target configuration header like aarch64.h, and not the RTL instruction-pattern description like aarch64.md.
